# netbox_cooling_intake (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/coolingintake/):

> A cooling intake is a liquid cooling inlet on a device.

Requires NetBox v4.7.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_cooling_intake" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `cooling_outflow_id` (Number) The upstream cooling outflow supplying this intake.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `diameter` (Number)
- `diameter_unit` (String) One of [mm, cm, in].
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `max_flow` (Number)
- `max_flow_unit` (String) One of [lpm, m3ph, gpm].
- `module_id` (Number)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `type` (String) One of [uqd, uqdb, qdc, camlock, npt, bsp, proprietary].

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
